title: KRISPY KREME® Invites Fans on a Sweet Escape with New Destination Dessert Collection
summary: Three all-new doughnuts inspired by beloved Latin American desserts available for a limited time beginning July 28 Beginning Tuesday, July 28, Krispy Kreme® is bringing the vibrant flavors of some beloved Latin American desserts to its new Destination Dessert Collection. Featuring three all-new doughnuts bursting with irresistible flavor, this limited-time collection marks the next stop on Krispy Kreme's global tour, following two summers of fan-favorite doughnuts inspired by Paris and Italy. Three all-new doughnuts inspired by beloved Latin American desserts available for a limited time beginning July 28 Krispy Kreme’s Destination Dessert Collection invites fans to discover three classic desserts reimagined as crave-worthy doughnuts with unique flavor pairings: Tres Leches-Inspired Doughnut – an unglazed shell doughnut filled with tres leches Kreme™, topped with sweet creme flavored buttercreme, cake doughnut crumbs, and cinnamon.
